profile.headline: Web Developer / Designer / SEO Specialist
profile.summary:
I have been using computers since I was a little kid. Taking them apart and putting them back together again. I'm not a computer repair man but I could easily be one. I went to school in 2003 and have been programming and designing ever since. School was good for getting me a degree but the best experience is what I continue to learn everyday in HTML, DHTML, XML, PHP, CSS, ASP, AJAX, etc.... 

I'm not necessarily looking for a full time job. I have a lot of freelance clients to keep me busy on a daily basis but if something should come along that's too good to resist, I will take it. So If you have something you think may interest me, please feel free to send me a message

Specialties: Advanced Professional Designer and Illustrator, Creation of Business identities, Vector graphics, GUI's, Internet Marketing, Search Engine Optimization, Wordpress, Ecommerce, etc..

positions.title: Web Designer / SEO Specialist
positions.description:
Mafcote is the corporate company for leading paper manufacturers like Geographics, Sonburn, Royal Lace and Royal Brites. They required three separate employees and decided to fill those three positions with me.

With Mafcote my primary  job responsibilities include:

• Creation of all web graphics including email newsletters, logos, site design, banner ads.
• Package design for international products.
• Basic programming support for IT department in Romania.
• Creation of SEM Strategies for Geographics.com and Thepaperseller.com
• Analysis of specific industry competition (industry search results, keyword competitiveness, reciprocating links)
• Searching for well ranking sites for reciprocating link partners.
• Running reports on campaign progress.
• Creating Marketing Stratagies for International exposure.
• Running reports on specific market effectiveness
positions.insights: Skills: PSD to Wordpress · Responsive Web Design

positions.title: Owner / Graphic Designer / Programmer
positions.description:
3PRIME is a company that two friends and I started to provide good ethical web solutions for businesses.

Primary Job Responsibilities included:

• Creation of all graphics used for site wide web creation, ad banners, print.
• Chop up and coding of custom W3C Standard Code.
• Database creation, entry and editing.
• Flash design and animation
positions.insights: Skills: cPanel · PSD to Wordpress · WooCommerce · Responsive Web Design

positions.title: Owner / Search Engine Specialist / Programmer
positions.description:
SpiderGourmet is primarily the internet marketing end of 3PRIME. We wanted to separate search engine optimization from other aspects of web solutions including design and web creation.

With SpiderGourmet my primary job responsibilities included:

• Analysis of specific industry competition (industry search results, keyword competitiveness, reciprocating links)
• Cleaning up old out-to-date coding and replacing with W3C Standard code.
• Addition of meta data with relevance to on page content.
• Editing on-page alt, title and summary tags.
• Adding addition content with relevant keywords
• Searching for well ranking sites for reciprocating link partners.
• Running reports on campaign progress.
• Creation and monitoring of Google Adwords Campaigns
positions.insights: Skills: PSD to Wordpress · Responsive Web Design

positions.title: SEO Programmer
positions.description:
I was going to school for Digital Media when working at SEOMatrix, so I was able to earn school credits for my internship and get real world experience. At SEOMatrix, I was one of the programmers that implemented search marketing strategies for their clients. Although I wasn't going to school for SEO, it was good to add the knowledge to my education.

Key job functions include;

• Building websites from scratch and optimizing them so they can show up higher in a search engine.
• Full knowledge of proper meta coding
• Utilized Photoshop to produce necessary web graphics
• In charge of all design duties performed including new and redesigning websites
• Utilize a good workflow with proper planning and diagrams
